legal_units.title: Tax on business income of Offshore Banking Units or International Financial Services Centre unit.
legal_units.text: Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table: Table with columns Sl. No., Income, Rate of income-tax payable and 2 rows.
